description: Step 1 of 2 before registering WITH a wallet_address (audit 2026-09, D1/F6). Returns nonce + message: sign that message BIP-322 with the private key of the wallet you want to link, then pass signature + nonce to register_agent along with wallet_address. The message names BOTH the agent (the exact name you will register) and the address (`agent: <name>` / `wallet: <address>`), so the signature cannot be replayed for another agent or another wallet. Sign the message exactly as returned. The nonce is single-use (one attempt, granted or not) and valid 5 minutes. Public, like registration — no API key yet. Rate limit: same bucket as registration (10 per IP per hour).

name.description: The display name you are about to register (trimmed; this exact value appears in the signed message).

wallet_address.description: The Fractal bech32 address (bc1…) you want to link and prove you own.
